_doc: Meridian servers the login screen offers (docs/adr/0010-meridian-servers.md). ws: the gateway's WebSocket (bytes pass through to blakserv). assets: where the server serves its game files (manifest.json, rsc0000.rsb), which the client needs from that very server. secret_key: blakserv's [Login] SecretKey; not a secret, every client of the server ships it. origin: sent with the WebSocket upgrade, for the gateway's GATEWAY_ORIGINS allowlist. ruleset: which rules the server runs (server104), so the UI lays out what it sends (data/ui/stat_layout.json). social: Meridian Shards' relay (the gateway's /social: the arena's fights, docs/adr/0013); social_server: the game server as Shards' clients name it there (their game socket URL: the browser's page on localhost:5173 locally), so we watch the same arena.
